remarks: Welcome to this expansive 1,974 sq ft residence at Heights Crossing-Darien's premier new development offering elevated coastal living across the street from the Metro North station. This 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath home features three private en-suite bedrooms, a dedicated office, and a spacious open-concept layout filled with natural light from skylights and full-sized windows or French doors in every bedroom. The gourmet kitchen is outfitted with Wolf and Subzero appliances, a quartz waterfall island, and flows seamlessly into the living and dining areas, anchored by a gas fireplace and soaring ceilings. Step through French doors in the living room or primary suite to your expansive private patio-perfect for entertaining or unwinding outdoors. A formal foyer, walk-in closets, luxurious baths with separate full-size showers or tub, and an in-unit laundry room with washer and dryer complete the well-appointed interior. Enjoy covered parking, a dedicated storage locker, and access to premium amenities including a fitness and wellness center, golf simulator, breakout office spaces, and a fireside resident lounge and event space. Retail shops, restaurants, a grocery store, and pharmacy are moments away-with Darien's beaches and parks minutes from your front door. Luxury, location, and lifestyle-all in one. Available September 1st.
